## Problem

What user, product, reliability, or maintainability problem does this change solve?

## Change

What changed, and why is this the smallest appropriate boundary?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build:pages` when deployment paths or PWA assets change
- [ ] Visual Smoke is green for UI/browser-platform changes
- [ ] Mobile behavior checked when layout or navigation changes
- [ ] Persisted/imported data migration considered when state shape changes

## Risk / trade-offs

Describe meaningful failure modes, compatibility concerns, or intentionally deferred work.

## Visual evidence

Add screenshots when the user-facing UI changes.
